description: Registrar General's Department - Reformation of Birth and Death Registration Divisions in Dankotuwa, Nattandiya and Wennappuwa D/S Divisions in Puttalam District and Meda Dumbara, Patha Dumbara Kundasale and Panwila D/S Divisions in Kandy District with effect from 08.05.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal notice amending birth and death registration divisions under the Birth and Death Registration Ordinance (Chapter 110). It involves regulatory changes to administrative boundaries for registration purposes, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, land matters, or other specialized categories.
